nodes.title: Responsible gifts and customer inducements
nodes.text: Gifts and promotional incentives must not pressure customers to purchase. Campaign owners review value, messaging and eligibility, including telemarketing scripts, and keep an approval record.

nodes.title: Transparent representative identification
nodes.text: Representatives identify themselves, their institution and relevant third-party relationships before customer prospecting. Identification checks do not by themselves establish marketing-purpose disclosure or consent.

nodes.title: Permission before marketing contact
nodes.text: Disclose the purpose of marketing contact and obtain permission before prospecting. Record verbal, written or event-registration consent and respect withdrawals across in-person and telephone channels.

nodes.title: Campaign gift approval and monitoring
nodes.text: Review gift eligibility and campaign messaging before release; sample approved campaigns for inducement concerns and retain review evidence.

nodes.title: Sales and telemarketing script assurance
nodes.text: Check sales and telephone scripts for inappropriate gift inducements; record assurance findings and remediation decisions.

nodes.title: Representative identification spot checks
nodes.text: Sample prospecting interactions for representative and institution identification; retain results and refer exceptions for review.

nodes.title: Conduct risk
nodes.text: Risk of unfair customer outcomes caused by inappropriate marketing or sales conduct.

nodes.title: Inappropriate sales inducement
nodes.text: Gifts, incentives or pressure may inappropriately influence a purchase decision.

nodes.title: Unclear customer communication
nodes.text: Customers may not understand the representative identity, institution relationship, marketing purpose or consent choice.
